qualitative_activity_claims.claim: The 1018 single-substitution SPOT library was tested at about 6.25 uM against MRSA SAP0017 biofilms; text reports a range from 25% residual biofilm for a more active derivative versus 31% residual biofilm for parent 1018 to inactive derivatives.
Eighteen of 108 SPOT-synthesized Experimental Validation Set peptides inhibited MRSA SAP0017 biofilm growth at the tested concentration.

qualitative_activity_claims.claim: Peptide 3002 is reported as eight-fold more potent than 1018 in vitro, inhibiting MRSA biofilm growth at concentrations as low as 1 uM and reducing preformed flow-cell biofilms at 0.125 uM.
